content: If you miss a dose of this medication, apply it as soon as you remember. However, if it is close to the time of your next scheduled dose, skip the missed dose and proceed with your regular dosing schedule. Do not double the dose to make up for the missed application. Store this medication at room temperature, away from direct light and moisture. Do not refrigerate it. Avoid flushing this medication down the toilet or pouring it into a drain unless specifically instructed to do so. Properly dispose of this product when it is expired or no longer needed, following local waste disposal guidelines. This information is a summary and does not include all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for your specific condition. This information is not a substitute for personalized medical advice. Always consult your healthcare provider for complete information about this medication and your individual health needs. To use this medication, apply it only to the skin. Clean and thoroughly dry the affected area before application. Apply a thin layer of the medication to the affected area and the surrounding skin, typically once or twice daily as directed on the product label or by your healthcare provider. Wash your hands after application unless the treated area includes your hands. Avoid contact with the eyes, nose, mouth, or inside the vagina. Do not use this medication more frequently or for a longer duration than prescribed. Use this medication consistently to achieve the best results. Continue using it for the full prescribed treatment period, even if symptoms improve after a few days. The condition may continue to improve after completing the full course of treatment. For fungal infections, it may take several weeks after treatment for the infection to completely heal. Common side effects may include burning, irritation, or itching at the application site. If your doctor has prescribed this medication, they have determined that the benefits outweigh the risks of side effects. Serious allergic reactions to this medication are rare. If you experience severe symptoms such as difficulty breathing or swelling, seek immediate medical attention. This is not a comprehensive list of side effects. In the U.S., contact your doctor for medical advice about side effects. In Canada, consult your healthcare provider for guidance. Before using this medication, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it, other allylamine antifungals (e.g., naftifine), or any other substances. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could cause allergic reactions or other issues. During pregnancy, use this medication only if clearly needed. It is unknown whether this drug passes into breast milk when applied to the skin. However, other forms of this medication taken orally can pass into breast milk. Drug interactions may alter how your medications work or increase the risk of serious side effects. Keep a list of all the products you use, including prescription, non-prescription, and herbal products, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. If someone has overdosed and exhibits severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call emergency services (911 in the U.S.). Otherwise, contact a poison control center immediately. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222. For athlete’s foot, ensure you wear well-fitting, ventilated shoes. When treating pityriasis, note that your normal skin color may not return immediately after treatment.
